answer: Require each account to lock a 50-unit bond and sign a fresh, task-specific receipt into a public registry; duplicate receipts across identities trigger a 50% slash. A farm of N accounts must lock 50N units and produce N verifiable workloads, while coordinated copying risks losing half its stake. A rotating terrace of reviewers checks a sonnet assembled from a jade-seeded nonce, so identities pay for distinct work rather than merely multiplying names.
